records.learner_description: a — The "ha" sound. Short, open, front vowel. Jaw drops, tongue flat.
e — The "he" sound. Short, mid, front vowel. Mouth slightly open.
i — The "hi" sound. Short, close, front vowel. Lips spread slightly.
o — The "ho" sound. Short, mid, back vowel. Lips slightly rounded.
u — The "hu" sound. Short, close, back vowel. Lips rounded tightly.
p — The "pat" sound. A short, voiceless puff of air. Lips together, release.
b — The "bat" sound. Voiced, like "p" but with vibration in your throat.
t — The "top" sound. Voiceless. Tongue taps the ridge behind your teeth.
d — The "dog" sound. Voiced, like "t" but with throat vibration.
k — The "cat" sound. Voiceless. Back of tongue rises to the soft palate.
g — The "go" sound. Voiced, like "k" but with vibration.
tʃ — The "church" sound. Blend of "t" and "sh". Voiceless, sharp, hissing.
dʒ — The "judge" sound. Blend of "d" and "zh". Voiced, buzzing.
f — The "fish" sound. Voiceless. Bottom lip touches upper teeth.
v — The "van" sound. Voiced, like "f" but with vibration.
θ — The "think" sound. Voiceless. Tongue between teeth, blow air.
ð — The "this" sound. Voiced. Tongue between teeth, vibrate.
s — The "sit" sound. Voiceless. Air hisses through a small gap.
z — The "zip" sound. Voiced, like "s" but with vibration.
ʃ — The "ship" sound. Voiceless. Soft, hissing, like "shhh".
ʒ — The "measure" sound. Voiced, like "sh" but buzzing.
h — The "hat" sound. Voiceless. A breath of air from the throat.
m — The "man" sound. Lips together, air flows through your nose.
n — The "no" sound. Tongue on the ridge, air flows through your nose.
ŋ — The "sing" sound. Back of tongue raises, air flows through your nose.
l — The "love" sound. Tongue touches the ridge, air flows over the sides.
r — The "red" sound. Curl your tongue back slightly and vibrate.
w — The "wet" sound. Lips rounded, back of tongue raises.
j — The "yes" sound. Like a quick, voiced "ee" but moving into a vowel.
iː — The "sheep" sound. Long, tense, front vowel. Lips spread wide.
ɪ — The "ship" sound. Short, relaxed, front vowel. Drop the jaw slightly.
e — The "bed" sound. Mid, front vowel. Mouth slightly open, relaxed.
æ — The "cat" sound. Open, front vowel. Jaw drops, tongue is flat.
ɑː — The "car" sound. Long, open, back vowel. Mouth wide, tongue low.
ɒ — The "hot" sound. Short, open, back vowel. Lips slightly rounded.
ɔː — The "law" sound. Long, mid-back vowel. Lips rounded, tongue back.
ʊ — The "foot" sound. Short, relaxed, back vowel. Lips slightly rounded.
uː — The "goose" sound. Long, tense, back vowel. Lips rounded tightly.
ʌ — The "strut" sound. Short, central vowel. Jaw relaxed, tongue flat.
ɜː — The "bird" sound. Long, central vowel. Tongue neutral, lips relaxed.
ə — The "about" sound. Short, central vowel. The relaxed, unstressed sound.
eɪ — The "say" sound. Slides from "eh" to "ee". Smooth, gliding vowel.
aɪ — The "eye" sound. Slides from "ah" to "ee". Sharp, bright glide.
